verses.zh: 总要放母，只可取雏；这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。

verses.zh: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。

verses.zh: 「不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。

verses.en: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
verses.zh: 不可并用牛、驴耕地。

verses.zh: 不可穿羊毛、细麻两样搀杂料做的衣服。

verses.zh: 「你要在所披的外衣上四围做繸子。」

words.g: thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon

verses.zh: 「人若娶妻，与她同房之后恨恶她，

verses.en: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”
verses.zh: 信口说她，将丑名加在她身上，说：『我娶了这女子，与她同房，见她没有贞洁的凭据』；

verses.en: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.
verses.zh: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.zh: 信口说她，说：我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据；其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。』父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。

words.g: the + a dress, especially a mantle

verses.zh: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，

words.g: and + to chastise, literally  or figuratively

verses.zh: 并要罚他一百舍客勒银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休她。

verses.zh: 就要将女子带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将她打死；因为她在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中做了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

verses.zh: 「若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。

verses.zh: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死―女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

verses.zh: 「若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与她行淫，只要将那男子治死。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;
verses.zh: 但不可办女子；她本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。

verses.en: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.
verses.zh: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救她。

verses.zh: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了美索不达米亚的毗夺人比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。

verses.zh: 然而耶和华―你的神不肯听从巴兰，却使那咒诅的言语变为祝福的话，因为耶和华―你的神爱你。

words.g: to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent

verses.zh: 你一生一世永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益。

verses.zh: 「不可憎恶以东人，因为他是你的弟兄。不可憎恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。

words.g: an Edomite, or descendants from  Edom

verses.zh: 他们第三代子孙可以入耶和华的会。」

verses.zh: 「你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。

verses.zh: 「你们中间，若有人夜间偶然梦遗，不洁净，就要出到营外，不可入营；

words.g: from + an  occurrence, i.e. some accidental  disqualification

verses.zh: 到傍晚的时候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入营。

words.g: and + like + to come, go in

verses.zh: 「你在营外也该定出一个地方作为便所。

words.g: from + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.zh: 在你器械之中当预备一把锹，你出营外便溺以后，用以铲土，转身掩盖。

verses.en: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华―你的神常在你营中行走，要救护你，将仇敌交给你，所以你的营理当圣洁，免得他见你那里有污秽，就离开你。」

verses.zh: 「若有奴仆脱了主人的手，逃到你那里，你不可将他交付他的主人。

verses.en: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
verses.zh: 他必在你那里与你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他选择一个所喜悦的地方居住；你不可欺负他。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.zh: 「以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有娈童。

words.g: a  sacred person, i.e.  a  devotee  to licentious idolatry

verses.zh: 娼妓所得的钱，或娈童（原文是狗）所得的价，你不可带入耶和华―你神的殿还愿，因为这两样都是耶和华―你神所憎恶的。

verses.zh: 「你借给你弟兄的，或是钱财或是粮食，无论甚么可生利的物，都不可取利。

verses.zh: 借给外邦人可以取利，只是借给你弟兄不可取利。这样，耶和华―你神必在你所去得为业的地上和你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。

thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 「你向耶和华―你的神许愿，偿还不可迟延；因为耶和华―你的神必定向你追讨，你不偿还就有罪。

verses.en: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
verses.zh: 你若不许愿，倒无罪。

verses.en: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
verses.zh: 你嘴里所出的，就是你口中应许甘心所献的，要照你向耶和华―你神所许的愿谨守遵行。

verses.zh: 「人若娶妻以后，见她有甚么不合理的事，不喜悦她，就可以写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家。

verses.en: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

verses.zh: 「新娶妻之人不可从军出征，也不可托他办理甚么公事，可以在家清闲一年，使他所娶的妻快活。

verses.zh: 「不可拿人的全盘磨石或是上磨石作当头，因为这是拿人的命作当头。

verses.zh: 「若遇见人拐带以色列中的一个弟兄，当奴才待他，或是卖了他，那拐带人的就必治死。这样，便将那恶从你们中间除掉。

verses.zh: 他是磐石，他的作为完全；他所行的无不公平，是诚实无伪的神，又公义，又正直。

verses.en: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.zh: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻；有这弊病就不是他的儿女。

words.g: from + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.zh: 也吃牛的奶油，羊的奶，羊羔的脂油，巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊，与上好的麦子，也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。

words.g: Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
wheat, whether the grain or the plant

verses.zh: 但耶书仑渐渐肥胖，粗壮，光润，踢跳，奔跑，便离弃造他的神，轻看救他的磐石；

verses.zh: 我要向他们掩面，看他们的结局如何。他们本是极乖僻的族类，心中无诚实的儿女。

verses.zh: 他们以那「不算为神」的触动我的愤恨，以虚无的神惹了我的怒气。我也要以那「不成子民」的触动他们的愤恨，以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。

verses.zh: 我若磨我闪亮的刀，手掌审判之权，就必报复我的敌人，报应恨我的人。

verses.zh: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼；因他要伸他仆人流血的冤，报应他的敌人，洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。

verses.zh: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各，将你的律法教训以色列。他们要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。

verses.en: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
verses.zh: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上，悦纳他手里所办的事。那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰，使他们不得再起来。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men + +him/his/it
the waist or small of the back

verses.en: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
verses.zh: 论便雅悯说：耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住；耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。

words.g: to + Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob

verses.en: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
verses.zh: 论约瑟说：愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福，得天上的宝物、甘露，以及地里所藏的泉水；

words.g: and + to + Joseph, the name of seven Israelites

verses.en: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
verses.zh: 得太阳所晒熟的美果，月亮所养成的宝物；

verses.en: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
verses.zh: 得上古之山的至宝，永世之岭的宝物；

verses.en: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
verses.zh: 得地和其中所充满的宝物，并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。愿这些福都归于约瑟的头上，归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。

words.g: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
and + to + the crown of the head

verses.en: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
verses.zh: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严；他的角是野牛的角，用以抵触万邦，直到地极。这角是以法莲的万万，玛拿西的千千。

verses.en: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
verses.zh: 论西布伦说：西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。以萨迦啊，在你帐棚里可以快乐。

words.g: and + to + Zebulon, a son of Jacob
and + Jissaskar, a son of Jacob

verses.en: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
verses.zh: 他们要将列邦召到山上，在那里献公义的祭；因为他们要吸取海里的丰富，并沙中所藏的珍宝。

verses.en: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
verses.zh: 论迦得说：使迦得扩张的应当称颂！迦得住如母狮；他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。

words.g: and + to + Gad, a son of Jacob

verses.en: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”
verses.zh: 他为自己选择头一段地，因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。他与百姓的首领同来；他施行耶和华的公义和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。

verses.en: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
verses.zh: 论但说：但为小狮子，从巴珊跳出来。

words.g: and + to + Dan, one of the sons of Jacob
Dan, one of the sons of Jacob
a cub , especially of the lion
to draw together the feet , i.e. to spring forward
the + Bashan , a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
verses.zh: 论拿弗他利说：拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠，满得耶和华的福，可以得西方和南方为业。

words.g: and + to + Naphtali, a son of Jacob

verses.en: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.zh: 论亚设说：愿亚设享受多子的福乐，得他弟兄的喜悦，可以把脚蘸在油中。

verses.en: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
verses.zh: 你的门闩（或译：鞋）是铜的，铁的。你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。

verses.en: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
verses.zh: 耶书仑哪，没有能比神的。他为帮助你，乘在天空，显其威荣，驾行穹苍。

words.g: Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel

verses.en: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
verses.zh: 永生的神是你的居所；他永久的膀臂在你以下。他在你前面撵出仇敌，说：毁灭吧。

verses.en: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
verses.zh: 以色列安然居住；雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。他的天也滴甘露。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
verses.zh: 以色列啊，你是有福的！谁像你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？他是你的盾牌，帮助你，是你威荣的刀剑。你的仇敌必投降你；你必踏在他们的高处。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +you/your
to be open, wide or free
and + to be untrue, in word  or deed
and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
verses.zh: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毗斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity
the + Pisgah, a Mountain East of Jordan
Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
the + Gilad, a region East of the Jordan
Dan, one of the sons of Jacob

verses.en: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,
verses.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲、玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，

words.g: and + Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
verses.zh: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。

words.g: the + a circle, i.e.  a circumjacent tract or region
a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan

verses.en: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
verses.zh: 耶和华对他说：「这就是我向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：『我必将这地赐给你的后裔。』现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。」

words.g: to + Abraham, the later name of Abram
and + to + Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch

verses.en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.
verses.zh: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
verses.zh: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地、伯・毗珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan
Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan

verses.en: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
verses.zh: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁；眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。

words.g: to be weak, i.e.  to despond

verses.en: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
and + to complete, in a good or a bad sense

verses.en: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚；因为摩西曾按手在他头上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。

words.g: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua

verses.en: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.zh: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。

verses.en: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.zh: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to + Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings

verses.en: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
verses.zh: 又在以色列众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
